# Artha Trading Journal

> The beautiful, automated trading journal for serious traders

## What is Artha?

Artha is an automated trading journal web application that helps traders identify winning setups and master their psychology. It replaces messy spreadsheets with automatic broker syncing, FIFO-calculated P&L, and AI-powered performance coaching.

## Core Features

### Automatic Broker Syncing
- Zero manual entry - connect your broker once and every trade syncs automatically
- Supports 100+ brokerages including Interactive Brokers, Schwab, Zerodha, Robinhood, and more
- Powered by SnapTrade API with bank-level security
- AES-256 encrypted data storage
- Real-time trade synchronization

### Psychology Tracking
- Tag every trade with setups, mistakes, and emotions
- Position-level tagging system (tags apply to entire positions, not individual trades)
- See exactly which patterns cost you money and which make it
- Track trading psychology patterns over time
- Filter analytics by tags to identify behavioral patterns

### Accurate P&L Calculation
- FIFO (First-In-First-Out) lot matching engine
- Supports stocks, options (standard 100x and mini 10x contracts), long/short positions
- Real-time profit/loss, win rates, and risk-reward ratios
- Filter by date range, account, symbol, or psychology tags
- Cross-account position tracking with accurate cost basis

### AI Performance Coaching (Pro)
- Personalized trading insights powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash
- Analyzes your trade history and psychology tags
- Identifies patterns in winning vs losing trades
- Actionable recommendations to improve performance
- Cached responses for fast performance

### Analytics & Reports
- Win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Risk-reward ratio analysis
- Performance by symbol, account, or tag
- Date range filtering for period analysis
- Visual charts and performance metrics

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4
- **Backend**: PostgreSQL (Supabase), Prisma ORM, NextAuth authentication
- **APIs**: SnapTrade (broker connections), Stripe (billing), Google Gemini / Groq (AI)
- **Security**: AES-256-GCM encryption, Row-Level Security (RLS), OAuth 2.0
- **Caching**: Upstash Redis for rate limiting and AI response caching

## Security & Privacy

- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM encryption for all sensitive data (broker credentials, account numbers)
- **Authentication**: OAuth 2.0 via Google, Apple, or Email Magic Links
- **Data Access**: Row-Level Security (RLS) ensures users can only access their own data
- **Compliance**: Broker connections via SnapTrade (SOC 2 Type II certified)
- **Privacy**: No data sharing with third parties; trade data remains private

## Common Questions

**Q: How does automatic syncing work?**
A: Artha uses SnapTrade's secure API to connect directly to your broker. Once connected, trades sync automatically - no manual CSV uploads or spreadsheet entry.

**Q: Is my brokerage supported?**
A: Artha supports 100+ brokerages via SnapTrade, including all major US brokers (Interactive Brokers, Schwab, Robinhood, etc.) and international brokers like Zerodha (India).

**Q: How is P&L calculated?**
A: Artha uses FIFO (First-In-First-Out) lot matching within each account. This ensures accurate cost basis and P&L for partial closes, averaging, and complex strategies.

**Q: Can I tag trades after they happen?**
A: Yes! Tags are applied at the position level (identified by account + symbol). You can tag positions anytime and filter all analytics by those tags.

**Q: What AI model powers the coaching?**
A: Artha uses Google Gemini 2.0 Flash as the primary model with Groq Llama 3.3 as fallback. Insights are cached for 1 hour for performance.

**Q: Can I try it before paying?**
A: Yes! Artha offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required. You can also try the demo mode without creating an account.

**Q: What happens if I cancel my subscription?**
A: You retain access until the end of your billing period, then your account switches to view-only mode. Your data is never deleted - you can reactivate anytime.

## Technical Details for Developers

- **Platform**: Web application (Next.js 16 App Router)
- **Authentication**: NextAuth with Google OAuth, Apple OAuth, Email Magic Links
- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Supabase) with Prisma ORM
- **Broker Integration**: SnapTrade SDK (REST API)
- **Payment Processing**: Stripe Checkout + Billing Portal
- **AI Integration**: Google Gemini API, Groq API
- **Caching**: Upstash Redis
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **Rate Limiting**: Redis-based with graceful degradation
